summary.zh-CN: 有假设、变量可量化、可抽样与统计检验的量研究，按问题、方法、结果、讨论组织。
summary.en: Quantitative research with hypotheses, measurable variables and statistical testing, organised as question, method, results, discussion.

whenToUse.zh-CN: 有明确的研究问题或假设
whenToUse.en: There is an explicit research question or hypothesis

whenToUse.zh-CN: 变量可测量，能做抽样与统计检验
whenToUse.en: Variables are measurable and can be sampled and tested

whenToUse.zh-CN: 数据来自实验、准实验、问卷量表或二手数据
whenToUse.en: Data comes from experiments, quasi-experiments, surveys or secondary sources

focus.zh-CN: 按领域、缺口、目的、研究问题或假设的顺序收拢，说明本研究补上的是哪一个缺口。
focus.en: Funnel from field to gap to purpose to question or hypothesis, naming the gap this study fills.

focus.zh-CN: 交代样本与抽样、工具与信效度、实施程序与分析策略，使他人可复现；区分验证性与探索性分析。
focus.en: Report sampling, instruments and validity, procedure and analysis strategy so the study can be reproduced; distinguish confirmatory from exploratory analysis.

focus.zh-CN: 按研究问题的顺序客观呈现结果，报告统计量、效应量与区间估计；不加解释与因果推断。
focus.en: Present results in question order with statistics, effect sizes and interval estimates; no interpretation.

focus.zh-CN: 按主要发现、与文献比较、理论与实践意义、局限、后续问题的顺序展开。
focus.en: Cover main findings, comparison with the literature, implications, limitations and next questions.

focus.zh-CN: 概括贡献与适用边界，不重复讨论细节，不越过数据下结论。
focus.en: Summarise the contribution and its boundary; do not repeat the discussion or overreach the data.

methodNotes.zh-CN: 假设写不写、效应量与统计检验是否适用，取决于实际研究设计；没有数据时结果标为待补，不生成数值。
methodNotes.en: Whether hypotheses, effect sizes or significance tests apply depends on the design; without data, results stay pending.
